description: This file defines a REST API resource class for handling Maker Checker (or 4-eye) functionality within the Apache Fineract platform. It provides endpoints to list, search, approve, reject, and delete maker-checker entries, utilizing various services and request parameters.

classes.name: MakercheckersApiResource
classes.description: A REST controller class providing Maker Checker related endpoints for listing, searching, approving, rejecting, and deleting maker checker entries.

methods.name: retrieveCommands
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a list of maker checker entries based on optional filtering criteria.

methods.name: retrieveAuditSearchTemplate
methods.description: Provides a template for searching maker checker entries, useful for building a UI.

methods.name: approveMakerCheckerEntry
methods.description: Handles POST requests to approve or reject a maker checker entry based on command parameters.

methods.name: deleteMakerCheckerEntry
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove a maker checker entry.
